summary: Hudbay Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release on an updated Snow Lake mine plan, not a special situation. Reserve mine life extends two years to 2043, adding six years total with the March 2026 extension; 2026-2030 average annual gold production rises to 185,000 ounces, a 37% increase over the 2021 technical report, with life-of-mine gold output up 60% to 2.8 million ounces. Reserves grew 38% in tonnage to 27 million tonnes containing 2.0 million ounces of gold; resources rose 26%. Five-year average gold cash costs are $821 per ounce and sustaining cash costs $1,379 per ounce. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation apply; watch execution at 1901 and Stall.
